name: approvals-banner help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:approvals-banner. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: …and more
entries.text: More calls are waiting than fit here. Tap for the full list.

entries.title: Gets louder over time
entries.text: The alarm starts soft and builds up, so it doesn't make you jump.

entries.title: Seconds to full volume
entries.text: How long the alarm takes to reach full volume.

entries.title: Rings for
entries.text: How long each ring lasts, in seconds.

entries.title: Rings
entries.text: How many times it rings. 1 = once, no repeat.

entries.title: Ring through silent mode
entries.text: On the phone, rings even when it's on silent. For calls you really can't miss.

entries.title: Approvals banner
entries.text: Its settings: notices, the alarm, when it shows.

entries.title: Allow notifications
entries.text: Lets this browser show a notice when a call starts its countdown.
